data.title: Sequences of Rigid Motions and Congruence
data.description: Practice building sequences of reflections, rotations, and translations to map figures onto target images and explore congruence on the coordinate plane.

challenges.narration: A puzzle piece needs several moves to fit.
challenges.instruction: Use the transformation buttons to move the pink figure exactly onto the dashed target. It takes more than one move.
challenges.hint: First match the orientation with a flip or a turn, then slide the figure onto the target with the arrow buttons.
challenges.transformLabel: Reflection over the y-axis followed by a translation by (-1, -1)

challenges.narration: A robot arm must move the part onto the target.
challenges.instruction: Use the transformation buttons to move the pink figure exactly onto the dashed target. It takes more than one move.
challenges.hint: First match the orientation with a flip or a turn, then slide the figure onto the target with the arrow buttons.
challenges.transformLabel: Reflection over the x-axis followed by a translation by (2, 1)
